lines: H-Hey, Fumaaa!? There's some monster agaiiiiiiiiiiin!!!
H-Hey!!? Stop clinging with your sniveling face!
W-Wait, you two!! This smell is...
The owner of the footsteps appeared from the darkness in front of us while we were panicking in confusion.
Hebiko knew it... she thought she had felt that smell somewhere before.
The person who appeared was Clear, the young girl living with Yukikaze.
Clear was an augmented human created to destroy demons,
but due to some circumstances, she came under the protection of Gosha and was now living in Yukikaze's house.
As Clear prepared her sword, an ominous sound emanated as the sky-blue blade activated.
N-No, that's not it!! I'm... look! I came to give Yukikaze her notebook back!
Clear might look like a little girl, but she was actually so strong that she could fight evenly against Yukikaze.
? I see... Old man said thieves. Was noisy.
Clear silently put her blade away.
So, that's why you came here...
(Hmm? She said "old man" so that means...)
Clear. So that ghost really is a butler of this house?
In the first place, I wondered if a ghost could even work as a butler, but I decided to put that aside for now and just check with her.
Yes. Old man is butler. Always make me stir-fried vegetables.
But if he really was the butler, then we had our play.
So could you tell him for me, Clear? Tell that ghost old man that we're not thieves.
Sorry, Fuma. This. I can't do...
Clear spoke in a slightly sad voice.
As I was about to ask back, I suddenly realized.
(Could it be... that Clear, and that ghost old man are...!)
The young girl created to destroy demons, and the butler who looked like an evil spirit monster.
It wouldn't be unusual in the slightest if they weren't on good terms, or if she was being bullied by him...
The reason was a lot more floolish than I thought.
Forgot he made dinner. Made several times. stir-fried vegetables.
He said, "eat a lot and grow up big, ohohohoh."
Sounds like he really likes you!!
It looked like Clear was having a good time in Yukikaze's house, which made me feel relieved.
I'm... kind of less afraid of monsters now...!
W-Well... even if you can't, what about Yukikaze? He must listen to what his master tells him, right?
As I asked, Clear nodded her head up and down.
Okay. He listens to Yukikaze. A little.
A little is a bit worrying... but Yukikaze's our only shot left huh. Clear, can you guide us?
Yes. Yukikaze's room. Close to mine.
Thank you! Then let's go to your room first!!
Finally, we started to see the light at the end of this incomprehensible situationーbut, at that moment...
『So that's where you were, boy! I will not let you escape!!』
Together with a voice echoing from somewhere, the group of scarecrows rushed toward us.
Aiiiiieeee!! The scarecrows are here agaiiiiiin!
Damn!! Everyone, let's push them back!
